subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The teacher praised the student for his __diligent__ work and consistent effort.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"diligent"** means showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties. (मेहनती)

 
 
• **Example: **She was** diligent **in her studies, ensuring she reviewed her notes every night.
 
 
 
• **"Lazy"** refers to someone unwilling to work or use energy; idle. (आलसी)
 
 
• **Example: **He was too **lazy **to get up and turn off the light, so he slept with it on all night.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'diligent'** is **'lazy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Frazzle **(थकावट): To exhaust physically or emotionally.

 
 
• **Example:** The long journey frazzled everyone, and they fell asleep as soon as they reached home.
 
 
 
• **Persistent **(दृढ़): Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action despite difficulty or opposition.
 
 
• **Example: **Her persistent efforts finally paid off when she passed the exam.
 
 
 
• **Squander** (बर्बाद करना): To waste something, especially money or time, in a reckless and foolish manner.
 
 
• **Example:** He squandered all his savings on expensive gadgets he never used.
